verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time (anytype-docs-20) and export all your channels (anytype-docs-23), with Markdown as an export format alongside the native Any-Block format (anytype-docs-11). The local API and agent skill also give programmatic access to your Objects (anytype-docs-1, anytype-docs-5), offering a scripted exit path. Missing for 10: evidence that Markdown export preserves structured data (Types, relations, databases); an open tabular/structured export format such as CSV or documented JSON; independent or hands-on confirmation that a full export-and-leave works.
